# CDR covers Philipp Leibfried's insights from the Global Class Action Symposium


- Antitrust & competition


November 24, 2025


-
-
-
-


*CDR'* s coverage of a panel at Global Legal Group's Class Actions Symposium includes insights from Head of Europe[Philipp Leibfried](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/philipp-leibfried/) on the Competition Appeal Tribunal (CAT), where he says that "the next stages of development for the CAT \[rely\] on getting good cases certified and settled faster."


Read more[here](https://www.cdr-news.com/categories/litigation/gcas-2025-changing-times-in-the-uk-and-abroad/) .
